name: dhcp-resource-bounded-path-aware-dhcpv6-decoding
instr:
The dhcp library cannot resource-bound untrusted normal and relayed DHCPv6 packets. Add an opt-in policy covering options, labels, recursive envelopes, embedded payloads, clients, servers, and netboot exchanges without changing legacy behavior.

Limit bytes, options, depth, list entries, and expanded label bytes independently. Zero means unlimited; fresh contexts start empty. Debit framing, RFC1035 labels, nested option sets, relay envelopes, and embedded DHCPv4 payloads cumulatively. Reject before exhausted limits expose state. Report failures as standard-matchable `DecodeError` values with immutable packet-scale path, resource, limit, observed amount, and option code.

Fixed-width address lists preserve wire order, publish complete entries atomically within entry and byte budgets, and report incomplete trailing addresses at precise option paths. Boot parameters report truncation by index and never publish over-limit entries. Domain-search and FQDN share bounded label expansion but preserve distinct fields and paths. IA Prefix, 4RD, and DHCPv4Msg share depth, entry, and byte budgets according to representation. Reject exhausted depth before subordinate decoding; publish IA Prefix fixed fields only after subordinate options succeed.
